title: The Previous Master
summary: Lin Dong's Destiny Symbol leads him to a hall where Elder Cao of the Yin Puppet Sect is binding a high-grade Symbol Puppet, and Lin Dong forces Cao to give it up. Teng Lei arrives and fights Mu Qianqian, thinking she has it. Lin Dong drags Cao down through the Nine Underworld Cold Qi, but the altar below is empty, because the Yin Puppet Sect's master took the treasure three years ago. Inside a black stone pillar, Lin Dong meets the previous master of the Devouring Ancestral Symbol. The old man tests him with his memories, approves of him, and gives him the means to break the Ancestral Symbol's seal, warning that its power comes with a duty. Back outside, Lin Dong turns the high-grade Symbol Puppet on Teng Lei and his Yin Puppet Formation and drives them off. Mu Qianqian then tells him about the Manifestation Martial Tablet.
events: Lin Dong catches Elder Cao binding a high-grade Symbol Puppet and forces him to give it up.
Teng Lei accuses Mu Qianqian of taking the puppet, and their groups fight.
Lin Dong takes Cao down through the Nine Underworld Cold Qi to an empty altar; Cao says the Yin Puppet Sect's master took the treasure three years ago.
Through a black stone pillar Lin Dong meets the previous master of the Devouring Ancestral Symbol, who recognises Little Mink as a Celestial Demon Marten.
The old man tests Lin Dong with his memories, approves of him, and gives him what he needs to break the Ancestral Symbol's seal.
Lin Dong leaves Cao behind as promised, then crushes Teng Lei's Yin Puppet Formation with the high-grade Symbol Puppet, which burns through his Pure Yuan Pills.
Mu Qianqian tells him about the Manifestation Martial Tablet, where Manifestation-grade martial arts can be won.
cultivation: Only Manifestation experts can normally pass the Nine Underworld Cold Qi. The previous master of the Devouring Ancestral Symbol approves Lin Dong. The high-grade Symbol Puppet runs on Pure Yuan Pills and drains them fast.

gains: the previous master's seal-breaking gift for the Devouring Ancestral Symbol
losses: most of his Pure Yuan Pills (burned by the puppet)
places: ancient sect hall inside the tablet
space inside the black stone pillar
ancient sect hall (fight with Teng Lei)

changes: First review for this episode; no older summary to correct.
flags: The old man is never named in this episode; he calls himself the previous master of the Devouring Ancestral Symbol (837.1). In EP36 Little Mink calls the same elder 黑瞳师尊 (1179.4), which is the wiki's Black-Eyed Elder (names.txt EP35).
870-918 is the test: flashback lines from earlier seasons (Lin Langtian's 蝼蚁, Ling Qingzhu's farewell, children mocking Lin Dong's father). Those people are not in the cast.
955.2 去: the object the elder gives Lin Dong is not named; he says to use it to break the Devouring Ancestral Symbol's seal (959.4).
928.2 我的符石: Lin Dong means his Stone Talisman (石符); the characters are reversed in this line.
Elder Cao is the one who goes down with Lin Dong and complains about it (550.7, 592.2); he is left behind at 1054.4.
Card 292.7 is Elder Cao's first face-to-face line to Lin Dong; 261.4 is where he is named.
